why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Install the HaHa wallet Get HaHa from the App Store , Google Play or the Chrome Web Store and set up a wallet.

2 Step 2 : Earn Karma through everyday use Make in-app swaps, stake through HaHa on FastLane or Kintsu, deposit into its vaults, and open the app daily for the check-in bonus. Karma also comes from quests and trading competitions.

3 Step 3 : Join the community and partner activities Take part in Discord events and raffles, hold a partner NFT, or join partner quests, all of which the Season 1 post lists as ways to raise your share.

4 Step 4 : Check eligibility on the airdrop checker Open the airdrop checker , connect your wallet or enter an address, and see which SBTs were dropped to it. SBTs go to your designated default wallet.

5 Step 5 : Follow the rules on farming and bugs Commercial farming, exploiting bugs or non-intended use, such as swapping MON and WMON, can lead HaHa to revoke SBTs and future HAHA allocations. Details are in the Season 1 post .
